name: Case law: Nidwalden (cantonal courts and bodies)
label: Switzerland case law (Nidwalden)
coverage: 1054 published decisions, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 18565 citations of federal law linked to switzerland-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day the decision was given (the publication day where the court gives no decision day). Decisions with no date at all are in decisions/<court>/undated/. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01 (a second apart); In-force holds the real day.
